description: This PHP class defines the 'Screen' entity mapping to the 'ohrm_screen' database table. It includes properties such as id, name, action URL, associated module, optional menu configurator, and related permissions, along with their respective getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Screen
classes.description: Represents a user interface screen with properties like name, URL, related module, menu configuration, and permissions, mapped to database using Doctrine ORM annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the screen.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the screen.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the screen.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the screen.

methods.name: getActionUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the screen's action.

methods.name: setActionUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL associated with the screen's action.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the associated module entity for the screen.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Associates a module entity with the screen.

methods.name: getMenuConfigurator
methods.description: Returns the optional menu configurator string.

methods.name: setMenuConfigurator
methods.description: Sets the optional menu configurator string.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Returns the collection of permissions associated with the screen.

methods.name: setScreenPermissions
methods.description: Sets the collection of permissions for the screen.
